rationale: Planning did not fully carry the accepted file-structure decision into durable roadmap work. It correctly created one atomic first task (TASK-010) for the drift lens and correctly deferred source migration/UI work until drift evidence existed, but it left the downstream accepted cohort only as open questions in the decision/planning builds. After TASK-010 closed, the roadmap had 0 open tasks, so the accepted concept-root migration direction and human review surface had no queued executable follow-up. This violates the planning compiler expectation that accepted related executable cohorts use roadmap tasks and/or sprint metadata rather than relying on build open questions or chat memory. User explicitly requested this process report on 2026-05-23.
